purpose: Backend registry of reusable blueprints and major data-layer entry points. A blueprint defines fields, sources, normalization rules, temporal models, relationships and refresh logic inherited by concrete records.
inheritance_rule: Concrete records store observations and relationships; instructions belong to the parent blueprint.

blueprints.applies_to: all canonical countries

populations, peoples, citizens, residents, language communities, religious communities, political constituencies, cultural communities, classes, occupations, institutions, diasporas and project-symbolic dwellers

ancient mystery and initiatory cult records
modern and historical occult/initiatory order records
denominations, schools, rites and theological movements

automation_rule: Blueprints are executable specifications. Acquisition jobs read them to discover fields, sources, refresh intervals, validators, derived measures and relationship templates. Missing data is recorded as missing, never silently fabricated.
frontend_rule: Backend depth must be reachable through a small set of human-readable hubs. Raw registries are not themselves the primary navigation experience.
